# forgejo_access_token (Resource)

Forgejo access token resource. Manages personal access tokens for API authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    forgejo = {
      source = "svalabs/forgejo"
    }
  }
}

provider "forgejo" {
  host = "http://localhost:3000"
}

variable "test_password" { sensitive = true }

# User
resource "forgejo_user" "ci_user" {
  login    = "ci"
  email    = "ci@example.com"
  password = var.test_password
}

# Access token for the CI user
resource "forgejo_access_token" "ci_token" {
  username = forgejo_user.ci_user.login
  name     = "CI Token"
  scopes   = ["repo", "admin:org_hook"]
}

# Output the token (marked sensitive for security)
output "ci_token" {
  value       = forgejo_access_token.ci_token.token
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Access token for CI user"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the access token.
- `username` (String) Username of the user to create the token for. This explicitly specifies which user owns the token.

### Optional

- `scopes` (List of String) List of scopes for the access token (e.g., 'repo', 'admin:org_hook').

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the access token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The actual access token value. This is only available when the token is first created and cannot be retrieved later.
